items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Emmett Scott was a guitar player, wasn't he?

ctx.x: Well, anyway, you got the original tuxedo jazz band. You were looking at the tuba player here. Let's get the glass on it so you can see.
And who did you say that was? It looked like little Emmett Scott. What's his name? Emmett Scott was a guitar player, wasn't he?
Emmett Scott was a guitar player. Yeah, like you said before. It's Ellie. That's what you called him's nephew.
